# Harvest & Herd Co.

> Family-owned, grass-fed tallow-based natural skincare. Made in California in GMP-certified, solar-powered facilities. Hero product: Citrus & Honey Tallow Balm.

Harvest & Herd Co. is a California-based natural personal care brand founded in 2023. We formulate tallow-based skincare from 100% grass-fed and grass-finished beef tallow, paired with raw manuka honey, royal jelly, beeswax, and cold-pressed essential oils. Our manufacturing partners are FDA-registered and GMP-certified. All products are cruelty-free and family-tested.

## Products

- [Citrus & Honey Tallow Balm](https://www.harvestandherd.com/products/citrus-and-honey-tallow-balm): Hero product. Grass-fed tallow, raw manuka honey, royal jelly, organic olive oil, beeswax, sweet orange peel oil, sandalwood, rosalina, palmarosa, neroli, frankincense. 213+ reviews. $34.99.
- [All Products](https://www.harvestandherd.com/collections/all): Full catalog including the lip balm line and pipeline products.

## About

- [About Harvest & Herd](https://www.harvestandherd.com/pages/about-us): Family story, founding, manufacturing standards, and the "would we put this on our kids?" quality bar.
- [Contact](https://www.harvestandherd.com/pages/contact): support@harvestandherd.com · 833-789-HERD (4373) · 3857 Birch Street #3361, Newport Beach, CA 92660.
- [FAQ](https://www.harvestandherd.com/pages/faq): 31 questions covering tallow science, application, storage, skin-condition suitability, comparisons (vs shea, coconut, petroleum, hyaluronic acid), and our manufacturing approach.
